programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Premier League Hall of Fame: Gary Neville
programs.description: We sit down for an exclusive interview with the second of two new Premier League Hall of Fame inductees, Gary Neville. From his journey from Class of '92 prodigy to Premier League Hall of Fame icon, he talks us through the moments that defined his legacy at Manchester United. A story on one of the league's most influential right-backs and a leader whose impact still shapes English football today.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Regis Le Bris
programs.description: We join Regis Le Bris as he charts his meteoric journey from the training pitches of France to the dugout at Sunderland, where he masterminded an unlikely charge to the Premier League. Le Bris reflects on the philosophy and resilience that helped his side punch far above their weight. We also travel back to France to uncover the formative experiences and influences that shaped one of football's most intriguing modern managers.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Yankuba Minteh
programs.description: A firm favourite at Brighton and Hove Albion, Yankuba Minteh sits down with PL Stories and opens up on his journey from the streets of The Gambia to the pinnacle of the Premier League. We travel to his hometown to meet his parents and those who first recognised his talent, uncovering the roots of his relentless drive and humility. A story of resilience and rapid ascent, uncovering the challenges he's overcome, and the pride he carries for his home nation.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: The Forgotten Class of '92
programs.description: Three decades on from Manchester United's iconic Class of '92, PL Stories steps beyond the headline names to rediscover the teammates who shared the same dressing room, dreams, and demands of one of football's most revered youth systems. We sit down with the lesser-known graduates who lived that journey first-hand, players whose paths diverged from the global spotlight but whose experiences offer a rare and revealing window into the reality behind the legend.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Oliver Glasner
programs.description: A life-threatening head injury ended Oliver Glasner's playing career early, but it did nothing to quell his ambition. We go behind-the-scenes to reveal the makings of a manager who has achieved success throughout the past decade in European management, winning European titles in Germany, and the first major silverware in Crystal Palace's 120-year history.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Micky van de Ven
programs.description: We reflect on the rapid rise of Micky van de Ven, tracing his journey from a promising young defender in the Netherlands to becoming one of the Premier League's most electrifying modern centre backs. We sit down with van de Ven to explore the resilience, mentality and sheer speed, on and off the pitch that have defined his ascent.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Henrik Larsson
programs.description: We delve into the remarkable story of Henrik Larsson, tracing how a young talent from Sweden rose to become one of football's most celebrated forwards. Through candid interviews, Larsson reflects on the work ethic, determination and sharp footballing intelligence that powered his career across Europe and on the international stage. Visiting the clubs, coaches and moments that shaped him, we uncover the milestones, inspirations and unforgettable goals that forged his legacy as a player.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Fabian Hürzeler
programs.description: We chart the rapid emergence of Fabian Hürzeler, tracing his evolution from a young, inexperienced coach in his native Germany to becoming one of the Premier League's most progressive managerial voices. With unprecedented behind-the-scenes access at Brighton, Hürzeler opens up on the ideas, influences and leadership principles shaping his footballing philosophy. Revisiting the environments and mentors that defined him, we uncover the innovation that has powered his impact at the highest level.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Deadline Day Drama
programs.description: As the January transfer window reaches its dramatic conclusion, we explore the evolution of the Premier League's transfer market, from its early years to the high-stakes, global spectacle it is today. Revisiting some of the biggest and most transformative deals in Premier League history, we uncover the moments, motivations and manoeuvres that reshaped clubs and careers. Blending archive, insight and reflection, we reveal how deadline-day drama has come to define the modern Premier League era.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Antonio Valencia
programs.description: In the heart of Ecuador, we sit down with Antonio Valencia as he reflects on an extraordinary journey from humble beginnings to the grand stages of world football. Against the backdrop of the streets and stadiums that shaped him, he recounts his rise through adversity, his explosive emergence in the Premier League with Wigan, and his evolution into a title-winning, Champions League-chasing leader at Manchester United.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Andoni Iraola
programs.description: Andoni Iraola went from relative obscurity to leading a once relegation-threatened club to its highest ever points tally in the Premier League. We explore how his fearless philosophy, tactical innovation and emotional connection to the game have driven his teams to challenge expectations and rewrite their identity. A story of a Basque footballing icon, and his remarkable journey from Cyprus to the Premier League with Bournemouth in 5 years.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Shinji Okazaki
programs.description: With exclusive access in Germany, PL Stories follows the remarkable journey of Shinji Okazaki; from his beginnings in Japanese football to becoming a Premier League champion with Leicester City and now shaping the next generation through his club Basara Mainz.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Iliman Ndiaye
programs.description: Fresh from lifting the Africa Cup of Nations trophy with Senegal, Iliman Ndiaye reflects on a journey defined by resilience, imagination and quiet determination. From the academy pitches of France to the unforgiving grounds of non-league Boreham Wood, and on to the bright lights of the Premier League with Everton, we trace a rise that defied convention and expectation at every turn.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: PGMO and International Women's Day
programs.description: We mark International Women's Day by celebrating the women shaping refereeing across the professional game. We explore the past, present and future of officiating, spending a day on the road with PGMO officials Natalie Aspinall, Kirsty Dowle and Emily Carney as they open up about their journeys to the top of the game.

programs.title: Major League Baseball

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Unai Emery
programs.description: We shine a spotlight on Unai Emery, tracing the journey of one of Europe's most meticulous and innovative coaches from his roots in Spain to the pinnacle of the Premier League. Through exclusive interviews with his brother and the coaches who guided him in his early years, we uncover the dedication, detail and relentless drive that shaped his rise in the game.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Demba Ba
programs.description: Ahead of the Tyne-Wear Derby, we catch up with former Newcastle striker Demba Ba at USL Dunkerque, where he is 'Head of Football Operations'. He opens up about the challenges and rewards of his new role, while reflecting on a remarkable career in the Premier League that took him to West Ham United, Newcastle United and Chelsea. From unforgettable moments on the pitch to shaping his approach off it, Ba shares insights into the experiences that continue to influence his vision for the game today.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Willian
programs.description: We join Willian in Grêmio, Brazil, where he is currently continuing his playing career, as he reflects on an incredible journey in the Premier League. Sharing insights from his time at Chelsea and that controversial move across London to Arsenal and then Fulham, Willian opens up about the highs, challenges and defining moments that shaped his career at the top level of English football.

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Yakubu
programs.description: With exclusive behind-the-scenes access, PL Stories spends time with Yakubu Aiyegbeni at Finchley Boxing Club, where he is forging a new path in the next chapter of his sporting life. We explore his growing passion for boxing and the discipline it demands, offering a fresh perspective on life after football. Alongside this new pursuit, Yakubu reflects on his remarkable journey from his early years in Nigeria to becoming one of the Premier League's most prolific and respected strikers.

programs.title: Premier League World Beaters

programs.title: Premier League World Beaters
programs.description: We put the spotlight on some of the Premier League's biggest stars, including record-breaker Bruno Fernandes, France star William Saliba, and World Cup winner Alexis Mac Allister.

programs.title: Premier League World Beaters

programs.title: Premier League Stories
programs.subtitle: Soaring Seagulls
programs.description: 'Soaring Seagulls' tells the incredible story of Brighton & Hove Albion; from the brink of collapse and years in the lower leagues to becoming one of the Premier League's smartest and most admired clubs.
